Returns true when the sentinel's prev pointer is itself (classic empty-circular-list check). Confirmed via ChatMessageStream.kt guarding a getFirst() call. Confirmed real usage in this file's own method1877 companion helper: `method1872(8)` followed by repeated `method1878(...)` calls in a while loop, the canonical get-last/get-previous traversal idiom.

Walks the list from the sentinel via prev pointers back to the sentinel, counting nodes starting from `initial`. Repeatedly pops and unlinks the tail until the list is empty, then clears the shared cursor -- but only runs at all when `reason.toInt() == -45`; every real call site (ConfigArchiveLoader.kt, FrameStatsReset.kt, RegionSceneShifter.kt) passes exactly (-45).toByte(), so the guard is always satisfied in practice (not a dead branch, just a fixed opcode-shaped parameter).

Continues a backward traversal started by getLast(): returns the current cursor node (or null once the cursor reaches the sentinel, at which point it resets the cursor to null) and advances the cursor to that node's prev. Confirmed paired with method1872 in this file's own method1877 (`while (class318_sub10 != null) { ...; class318_sub10 = ...method1878(124.toByte()) }`).
